saw_lines: Perfume buyers pick one signature scent and rebuy it, so the first choice decides whether they come back.
So a new buyer decides fast whether to trust a store, and your ads give them no reason to act.
Your one copy runs in 9 of 29 ads, so keep the body, rewrite the opening line and swap the creative in each one.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 31 Oct 2026
points: One copy runs in 9 of 29 ads, so the same pitch reaches the same buyers. Keep the body, but rewrite the opening line and creative in each one. Open three ads with your site's question: which product suits you best.
None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a new buyer has no figure to weigh before clicking. Collect one real number, such as a review count or orders shipped, and open the next ads with it.

9 of 29 copy ads open on the same line, “laissez-vous séduire par l’élégance,” so the story repeats and new viewers scroll past. Test two new openers for the Lancôme ads, one naming a fragrance and one asking which scent fits.
None of your 29 ads carries an offer, so a first time buyer has no reason to act today. Add a first order offer or a bundle to the Rituals and Lancôme ads and state it in the opening line.

ads_1: New openers for the Lancôme ads, each with a first order offer
